displayName: OCI-AUTH-038: Authentication — Cross-Site Request Forgery on Auth
description:
Detects CSRF attacks targeting authentication endpoints

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: authentication — cross-site request forgery on aut

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_auth_038", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%authentication%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%cross%') AND "value" > 0
